text:
incident-bot: Paging page: infra.error_rate.high for eu-central-1 • 503 spikes > 20% sustained 2m • severity: P1

maria (oncall): acked, joining now :wave:

sam (sre): looking at metrics – 503s + request latency up. GPU queue length climbing on provider-gpu-3 in eu-central.

maria (oncall): confirmed. errors started ~10:02 UTC. Is it a provider-side flake or our routing?

sam (sre): netstat of the node shows healthy connections. kernel errs low. logs show downstream 502/503 from provider endpoints:
```
2026-03-15T10:03:12Z svc-proxy: upstream call failed provider-eu-3 503 ServiceUnavailable
2026-03-15T10:03:14Z runtime: kv-cache-miss spikes, queuing tokens
```

natalie (eng-lead): tagging potential culprit: heavy multimodal embeddings batch jobs + image gen feature are peaking in EU. Suggest partial brownout of image-gen in eu-central as immediate mitigation.

irfan (customer-ops): heads up — AcmeCorp reported errors at 10:04 UTC. They're heavy embedding users. Potentially impacted by disabling image-gen? They mostly do embeddings but have batch jobs scheduled.

sam (sre): plan proposal: 1) apply per-tenant soft rate limit for non-critical tenants in eu-central (quick config) 2) reroute a portion of traffic to provider-us-east (compatible model) 3) partial brownout: disable image-gen and large-batch embedding endpoints in the region (feature toggle) 4) monitor and escalate.

maria (oncall): agree. I'll start the soft rate limit and initiate a gradual provider reroute. Who will flip the image-gen toggle?

natalie (eng-lead): I'll do the image-gen toggle. We'll flip the flag for eu-central only and keep detailed logs. Expect ~30s for rollout. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam (sre): maria — rate-limit command ready:
```bash
# apply token-per-minute soft cap for non-critical tenants in EU
redwoodctl quota update --region eu-central-1 --scope non-critical --rate 60/m --mode soft
```

maria (oncall): running now. setting mode=soft so we can ramp back if false positive.

maria (oncall): confirmed: quota update accepted. service reported back: 200 OK.

maria (oncall): starting staged reroute of 25% of eu-central traffic to us-east:
```bash
# reroute 25% via traffic-split rule
redwoodctl routing set --from-region eu-central-1 --to-region us-east-1 --percent 25 --models all
```

incident-bot: Reroute job queued (job id 0b3f2). ETA ~ 45s to shift streaming rules.

sam (sre): monitoring qps and 5xx. watch for eviction thrash on KV cache when nodes see cross-region reads.

natalie (eng-lead): flipping image-gen toggle for eu-central now.

natalie (eng-lead): done — feature-image-gen: disabled for eu-central-1. Rolling back to config revision 487.

irfan (customer-ops): AcmeCorp says errors decreased for them after a minute, but they see slow responses on embeddings. Asking for ETA on full recovery.

sam (sre): initial metrics: 503 rate down from 22% -> 6% in 10m. Latency tail improved 30%. Provider queue length decreased.

maria (oncall): good. Next: increase reroute to 50% if metrics continue to improve, but we should avoid saturating us-east. Sam, can you validate capacity?

sam (sre): us-east spare capacity ~40% at the moment across compatible providers. We can move to 40% safely. I'll coordinate autoscale if needed.

maria (oncall): increasing reroute to 40% now.

incident-bot: Routing update applied (job id 0b3f2) -> now 40% rerouted.

lee (oncall-night): joining handoff early — saw the thread. Anything I should watch overnight?

maria (oncall): handing off in 30m. Current mitigations: soft rate limits on non-critical tenants in eu-central, 40% routing to us-east, image-gen disabled in eu-central. Owner: sam for runtime checks, natalie for feature toggle rollback. Keep an eye on provider-eu-3 error rates and KV cache RTT.

lee (oncall-night): ack. I'll keep paged channel open and monitor alerts. Please add runbook steps to the incident: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-failover

sam (sre): adding the quick diagnostic commands to the incident doc for night oncall:
```bash
# check 503s in last 5m
redwoodctl metrics query --metric errors.5xx --region eu-central-1 --since 5m
# check provider node queue
kubectl -n runtime exec -it provider-eu-3 -- curl localhost:9090/metrics | grep queue_length
```

irfan (customer-ops): updating affected customer list: AcmeCorp (high), BetaApps (medium), a few small PLG tenants (low). Communicating that we're mitigating and will follow up with post-incident notes.

maria (oncall): creating incident ticket and postmortem stub. tagging owners.

maria (oncall): handing off to lee in 25m. If we see >=10% 5xx again, revert the reroute and escalate to SRE shift lead.

lee (oncall-night): acknowledged. If I need assistance, I'll ping @sam and @natalie. Good notes, thanks. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> active. Incident channel: #incident-2105554321. Postmortem created: INC-2026-2105554321

maria (oncall): final note before handoff — remember to keep image-gen disabled until provider-eu-3 is marked healthy and we see stable 5xx < 1% for 30m. We'll schedule a cautious canary re-enable later.

lee (oncall-night): will do. switching alarms to 1m heartbeat. night team, please watch for cache thrash and cross-region latency spikes.

sam (sre): leaving monitoring hooks and a short dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood/prod/traffic/2105554321 :eyes:

irfan (customer-ops): I'll send a brief to impacted customers with an estimated timeline and note on the temporary brownout.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone — handoff in 5. :lock:

lee (oncall-night): handoff received.
